ops.title: Migrate legacy JSON drives before committing batch rows
ops.description:
Owner: drive-lock coordinator (caller).
Next executable step: retain a writing()/moved() initialization path for committed() when the drive has no database, before using the optimistic row-save path.
Evidence: cfc47e545 removed writing(name) from committed(). load() supports a legacy drive.json without a database (:1075-1077), but rows_saved() opens database_path directly and creates triggers on rows (:4748-4752) without TABLES. A changed batch on such a drive therefore creates an empty SQLite file, fails on the rows trigger, and subsequent load() sees that file and no longer reads the valid JSON. The old writing() path ran moved() before saving.
Static review only; no tests run.

ops.text: The first changed batch on a legacy JSON-only drive migrates and saves successfully.
A refused or failed migration does not leave a database that masks the valid legacy drive.
